The '''Besberra system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Cegul sector/Legends|Cegul sector]], part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the original location of [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="ZA" />
